en: Vintage divided-view postcard with two tinted photographs of a harbor. The upper image, labeled in German "Hafen" (harbor), shows a wooden pier with rail tracks running along it, leading toward moored sailing ships and steam vessels at sunset. The lower image, labeled "Die Rhede" (the roadstead), depicts several ships anchored offshore on a calm sea beneath pastel clouds. In the center of the card between the views appears the caption "Port Kunda".
